title: Understanding the Filter Condition
text: To determine if a building is modern, we need to check if at least 80% of its rooms were renovated in $$2003$$ or later. How can you express this condition using a lambda function?

title: Using the Renovated Column
text: Consider how you can use the 'renovated' column to filter rooms. What operation can you perform to check if the renovation year is $$2003$$ or later?

title: Calculate the Proportion of Modern Rooms
text: How can you calculate the proportion of rooms renovated in $$2003$$ or later? Use the sum of rooms renovated in $$2003$$ or later divided by the total number of rooms with recorded renovations.
